mouth.rule: eye-led expression with a single-stroke or filled micro-mouth; never paired equal-length outlines

neutral.visual_anchor: relaxed symmetric eyes and a steady centered gaze

happy.visual_anchor: soft crescent eyes, lifted outer brows and light cheek marks

laughing.visual_anchor: high crescent eyes with a two-beat buoyant laugh

caring.visual_anchor: soft lowered eyes with protective inward brows

affectionate.visual_anchor: large gentle eyes, close gaze and restrained cheek marks

curious.visual_anchor: asymmetric eyes, a raised brow and a side glance

surprised.visual_anchor: tall open eyes and clearly lifted brows

confused.visual_anchor: opposed brow angles and uneven eye heights

concerned.visual_anchor: raised inner brows, attentive open eyes and a lowered gaze

apologetic.visual_anchor: lowered brows, downcast eyes and a restrained posture
